title: Production Binding of WOFOST Owner-Controlled Persistence API
goal: Materialize the exact owner-controlled persistence view and reconstruction APIs already executable-qualified in F-WOF40 directly in production WOFOST owner modules, then rerun the F-WOF40 process-boundary qualification without qualification-time source generation on the positive path.
hard_constraints: production API must be semantically identical to the F-WOF40 candidate materialization
private authoritative event identity remains private; external code receives only serialization-neutral persistence data
reconstruction must validate owner state and receipt before publishing a ready transaction state
no TRANSFER/object-memory serialization or compiler-layout dependence
no file/path/parser/codec concern enters src/kernel or the WOFOST owner modules
parameters, forcing, solver scratch, retired accepted-window cache and derived views remain excluded from persistent state
no new commit authority, lineage setter, revision setter or rollback path
no crop physics, water mass accounting or numerical tolerance change
required_qualification: production source compiles O0 and O2 with -Wall -Wextra -Werror
production persistence API export/reconstruct roundtrip is exact
invalid owner and receipt persistence data fail closed
F-WOF38 atomic crop transaction gate remains green
F-WOF39 lifecycle retirement gate remains green
F-WOF40 producer/consumer true-process restart gate remains green
F-WOF40 positive path no longer materializes replacement owner source files
continuous versus restarted endpoint remains exact
nonclaims: not a production SWAP-wide restart format
not persistence of active unretired accepted-window state
not qualification of every WOFOST optional state layout
decision_rule: Close positively only if the production owner modules contain the already-qualified persistence API, the F-WOF40 process restart passes using those production modules directly, preservation gates remain green, and no serialization or commit authority leaks into the kernel or owner boundary.
